Whitty

Whitty is a quick, slightly crooked handwriting, in black and white only. Watch it write by itself, one crooked letter at a time.

Specimen

Hello, it's me again.

Click the text to type.

Info

Whitty is a handwriting typeface: the kind of writing that ends up on the back of receipts, in margins and on notes left on a table. Nothing is aligned, and nothing is meant to be.

It is a single style in black and white, with no colour at all. Every letter has several alternates, and the OpenType random feature picks a different one each time it appears, so no word is ever written the same way twice.
